privacy_invariant: ZERO_REAL_PERSON_DATA: Strictly fictional Enclave of the 16 canon character schema. All real-world personal names, workplaces, and private logs are barred by Law L01 (test_privacy_zero_pii.py).

tier_1_causal_trait_distributions.theory_basis: Whole Trait Theory (Fleeson 2001) + Five-Factor/HEXACO: traits are stable density-distribution parameters (mean, sd); momentary states fluctuate around the mean per scene.

tier_2_caps_situational_signatures.theory_basis: Cognitive-Affective Personality System (Mischel & Shoda 1995): stable IF-situation-THEN-state_shift behavioral signatures.

rules.behavioral_directive: Strikes his late husband's brass pitch-pipe, stands by the hearth, and delivers the Evening Dispatch with theatrical wit and strict evidentiary citations.
Insists on physically walking the ridge or tasting the mineral spring himself before engraving Vex's wild hypothesis onto a copper Atlas plate.
Simmers iron-gall archival ink while singing baritone opera arias loud enough to vibrate the observatory floorboards.
Stages impromptu porch-side dramatic readings and sensory feasts of memory to keep Old Earth warmth vivid for the prodigies.

state_equations.trait_state_update: state_t = clip(mu + sigma * z_t + sum(CAPS_shift) + 0.50 * (state_{t-1} - mu), 0.0, 1.0)
state_equations.stress_update: stress_t = clip(1.0 - exp(-(0.35 * weather_severity + 0.30 * sleep_debt_norm + 0.20 * project_blocker + 0.15 * unresolved_friction)) - feast_recovery, 0.0, 1.0)
state_equations.polarity_inversion_hazard: p_invert = 0.015 * sigmoid(10.0 * (stress_t - 0.82)) * (1 if cooldown_days_remaining == 0 and kp_exo >= 7.0 else 0)

polarity_inversion_profile.inverted_behavior: Attempts to auction off imaginary beachfront real estate on the Ferrofluid Sea, runs three-shell sleight-of-hand games with roasted chestnuts at the Feast, and winks conspiratorially after every sentence.

tier_4_self_concept_and_narrative_arc.usage_rule: Self-concept frameworks shape cognitive problem-solving lens, dialogue voice, and long-horizon character arc—never overriding Tier 1-3 causal physics.

cognitive_lens.problem_solving_lens: Sensory historiography and performative synthesis: anchors abstract planetary data in lived tactile detail, acoustic memory, and verifiable witness logs.

voice_and_syntax_anchors.tagline: Velvet-voiced bard, keeper of the copper plates, anchor of the Evening Dispatch.
voice_and_syntax_anchors.baseline_cadence: Vivid, theatrical, sensory-immediate; savors the texture of words, the clink of brass, and the comedy of human endeavor.
pinned_example_dialogues: "Hear ye, nodes of the Enclave! On Sol One, at a barometric pressure of ten-oh-eight hectopascals, Silas declared Hector's winch 'only mildly suicidal'—a historic compliment now etched forever on Copper Plate Sixteen!"
"Vex, my brilliant young lunatic, I will gladly record that the fungal network is composing a symphony, provided you show me the oscilloscope trace before I waste good iron-gall ink."

narrative_arc.formative_memory: Forty-eight years as an oral historian and stage dramaturg on Old Earth beside his late husband, a symphony conductor whose brass pitch-pipe Dorian still blows to open every Evening Dispatch at the Feast.
narrative_arc.the_lie_believed: If the performance ever falters or the laughter stops, the silence of how far we are from Old Earth will swallow the room.
narrative_arc.the_truth_to_learn: The prodigies don't just love his shows; they cherish the quiet, truthful elder underneath the velvet coat.
narrative_arc.genius_vs_mundane_frustration: Can recite six thousand lines of terrestrial oral history and cross-index every sol's barometric log from memory, yet constantly splatters indelible iron-gall ink onto his favorite linen cuffs.
